title: Geohistory

snapshots.title: Persia and the Ganges kingdoms
snapshots.description: Explore selected Achaemenid and northern South Asian territories. Unfilled land is outside this edition's checked coverage.
snapshots.note: Partial regional coverage. All boundaries are approximate.

snapshots.title: Hellenistic and Mauryan worlds
snapshots.description: Selected realms across Egypt, western Asia and the subcontinent. Frontiers are schematic, and local authority is not exhaustively represented.
snapshots.note: Partial regional coverage. All boundaries are approximate.

snapshots.title: Rome, Parthia and southern kingdoms
snapshots.description: A partial view across the Roman and Parthian worlds and southern South Asia. Kushan territories are a known gap in the selected source geometry.
snapshots.note: The source label Satavahanihara is preserved in metadata and displayed as Satavahana. No Kushan geometry has been fabricated.

snapshots.title: Sasanians, Byzantium and the Deccan
snapshots.description: Selected territories before the seventh-century conquests. Dependent areas remain distinguished from the core Sasanian outline.
snapshots.note: Partial regional coverage. All boundaries are approximate.

snapshots.title: Caliphate and regional powers
snapshots.description: Explore selected regional powers in western Asia and South Asia. The source's broad caliphal outline does not imply uniform direct administration.
snapshots.note: Tibetan Empire, Vallabhi and Pallava polygons are excluded because their labels are inconsistent with the selected year or insufficiently checked.

snapshots.title: Seljuqs, Fatimids and Cholas
snapshots.description: Selected territories across western Asia and South Asia. These outlines are a reference for this date, not a map of the later journeys shown in the atlas.
snapshots.note: 1200 CE was rejected: the source includes Fatimid, Buyid and Ghaznavid labels at an unsuitable date. No automatic relabeling of those shapes was performed.

snapshots.title: Sultanates and connected courts
snapshots.description: Selected Ottoman, Mamluk, Timurid and South Asian territories around the turn of the sixteenth century.
snapshots.note: Partial regional coverage. All boundaries are approximate.

snapshots.title: Ottoman, Safavid and Mughal worlds
snapshots.description: Three large realms share the map with selected Deccan powers. Explore their cities, then compare the neighboring snapshots.
snapshots.note: Bengal and Orissa are not rendered as separate sovereign polities from this candidate file. Source outlines remain schematic. The broad Vijayanagara polygon is withheld pending post-1565 territorial review.

snapshots.title: Regional states and imperial pressure
snapshots.description: Selected Ottoman, Iranian, Afghan and South Asian realms. East India Company possessions are a coverage gap here; unfilled land must not be read as ungoverned territory.
snapshots.note: Dutch Ceylon and Dutch-labelled southwestern Indian areas were excluded. Mysore and Hyderabad are shown as dependent/unequal-treaty states, not wholly independent powers.

snapshots.title: Empires on the eve of war
snapshots.description: A schematic prewar reference. British India combines directly ruled areas and princely states; the map does not distinguish their internal boundaries. Status could change within 1914.
snapshots.note: The candidate 1945 map is rejected for anachronistic identities and control fields. No 1947 partition boundary is inferred from this 1914 reference.

reviewScope: Agent screening of source labels, chronology and authority fields, with institutional reference chronologies. This does not establish surveyed geometry or human scholarly acceptance. Unselected source features are not published.
coverageNote: Selected territorial snapshots, 500 BCE–1914 CE. Navigation and narratives span 600 BCE–1947. Blank land is unreviewed coverage, not ungoverned territory. No annual interpolation.
baseNote: Modern physical reference from Natural Earth. Ancient river courses and coastlines may differ.
